narration:0:1820416001:0.text: Approaching the house, you can faintly make out some muffled voices.
narration:0:1820416001:0.source_cn: 靠近房屋，你隐约能听到一些模糊的说话声
narration:0:1820416001:0.male: Approaching the house, you can faintly make out some muffled voices.
narration:0:1820416001:0.female: Approaching the house, you can faintly make out some muffled voices.

narration:1:1820416002:0.text: You recognize one of the voices. It belongs to that despicable soldier.
narration:1:1820416002:0.source_cn: 你辨识出，其中一个声音属于那个可恶的士兵
narration:1:1820416002:0.male: You recognize one of the voices. It belongs to that despicable soldier.
narration:1:1820416002:0.female: You recognize one of the voices. It belongs to that despicable soldier.

narration:2:1820416003:0.text: Someone else is with him... I'll try to listen in.
narration:2:1820416003:0.source_cn: 还有另一个亡灵在场……悄悄靠近，听听他们在说什么吧

say:4:1820417001:0.text: The quality of this limb is good. I'm quite satisfied.
say:4:1820417001:0.source_cn: 这次肢体品质不错，我很满意。

say:5:1820417002:0.text: As expected of military-grade goods—far better than what other merchants offer.
say:5:1820417002:0.source_cn: 不愧是军队用的东西，比其他商人那里的货好多了。

say:6:1820417003:0.text: Of course. What good stuff could a backwater place like Novaris have? The limbs they use are just leftovers from our Bantus army!
say:6:1820417003:0.source_cn: 那当然。诺珐斯这种穷乡僻壤能有什么好东西？用的肢体都是...

say:7:1820417004:0.text: The truly good stuff—only our army has it!
say:7:1820417004:0.source_cn: 真正的好东西，只有我们军队里有！

say:8:1820417005:0.text: Our first deal went smoothly. I look forward to doing business again.
say:8:1820417005:0.source_cn: 第一次合作就这么顺利，你果然办事得力。我很期待后续的合作。

say:9:1820417006:0.text: However, my clients have a wide range of needs when it comes to limbs.
say:9:1820417006:0.source_cn: 不过，我的客户对肢体的需求范围可是很广的。

say:10:1820417007:0.text: Arms alone won't be enough. Can you source other types of limbs as well?
say:10:1820417007:0.source_cn: 只有手臂可不够。你还能提供其他部位的肢体吗？

say:11:1820417008:0.text: Hmph, don't underestimate the army's resources. With enough coin, I can get you any kind of limb you want!
say:11:1820417008:0.source_cn: 哼，别小瞧军队的资源。只要钱给够，什么样的肢体我都能弄来！

say:12:1820417009:0.text: Is that so? I'm glad you're so confident.
say:12:1820417009:0.source_cn: 是吗？很高兴你这么有自信。

say:13:1820417010:0.text: Though... you just had a conflict with the Repair House staff. That won't affect our dealings, will it?
say:13:1820417010:0.source_cn: 只是，你刚刚和修缮屋的员工起了冲突，这不会影响到我们的...

say:14:1820417011:0.text: Of course not. Those Graveborn won't be arrogant for much longer.
say:14:1820417011:0.source_cn: 当然不会，那些亡灵猖狂不了多久。

say:15:1820417012:0.text: I've already sent word back to the army via my hound. They'll send investigators to the Repair House soon and make those insolent Graveborn pay dearly.
say:15:1820417012:0.source_cn: 我已经写信让猎犬带回军队汇报。很快军队就会派人来调查修...

say:16:1820417013:0.text: You should hide this batch of limbs for now and wait until things cool down before moving them. Wouldn't want to get caught...
say:16:1820417013:0.source_cn: 你先藏好这批肢体，等风头过去了再出手，免得被发现……
